content_of_post_to_answer: What mindset shifts are necessary to reduce self-created struggles in life?
answer: Many self-created struggles come from treating thoughts as facts and temporary emotions as permanent truths. A useful shift is learning to separate what is happening from the story we attach to it. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone curious. The biggest freedom often comes not from controlling life, but from stopping the unnecessary battles we create with our own interpretations.
